title: With the bing provider, have an option to download UHD resolution images even if the resolution is 1920 x 1080 or lower.
line: The Bing Picture of the Day wallpaper now always downloads the sharp UHD image instead of the blurry 1080p one on regular landscape screens.
explanation: The Picture of the Day wallpaper asked Bing for the UHD image only on screens larger than 1920x1080 and for the 1920x1080 image otherwise. Bing compresses that 1080p image so heavily that it looks blocky and blurry even on a 1080p screen, while the UHD image downscaled to the same size looks clean. The wallpaper and its settings page now always request the UHD image for landscape screens; portrait screens still get Bing's 1080x1920 image.

commits.message:
wallpapers/potd: always download the UHD Bing image on landscape screens

Bing's 1920x1080 images are so heavily compressed that they look blurry
and blocky even on a 1080p screen, while its UHD image downscaled to the
same size looks clean, so use the UHD image for every landscape screen.

BUG: 487274

media.caption: Bing's 1920x1080 image as the wallpaper downloaded it, 2x zoom: blocky fur, eye and moss
Same region of the UHD image now downloaded, scaled to 1920x1080 and zoomed 2x: clean detail
1280x800 rig desktop with the Bing wallpaper (1920x1080 download, 285 KB)
Same desktop after the fix, now using the 3840x2160 download (851 KB)

reviews.text: Always requesting Bing's UHD image on landscape screens is a great KDE UX choice that avoids adding a Bing-specific checkbox while fixing the severe JPEG compression artifacts on Bing's 1080p images, clearly demonstrated in before-1.png vs after-1.png. Both main.qml and config.qml are updated consistently so they share the same cache entry, portrait screens keep using [1080, 1920], and Image.sourceSize keeps decoded memory usage proportional to screen size.

The reporter wants sharp Bing wallpapers on FHD screens. The 2x crops show the 1920x1080 download is badly over-compressed and the downscaled UHD one is clean, which answers Nate's c1 'no visual benefit' objection the same way c2-c5 did. Always requesting UHD for landscape screens, in both main.qml and config.qml, meets that need without a niche Bing-only checkbox, in line with KDE's preference for good defaults over options. The image is drawn at sourceSize and the engine only holds the decoded QImage briefly while caching it, so the cost is roughly 0.5 MB more download a day; metered connections are already skipped. Portrait screens and other providers are untouched. Nit: the 'Bing supports 1366/1920/UHD' comment and the w > 1920 sizing logic are now only used for the portrait check.
